requirements_summary: Workload types: real-time pricing (primary, hard SLO), chat ops (secondary), embeddings for memory store, reranking for order matching
Latency/throughput: p95 < 20ms for pricing path at sustained 500 rps across regions; p99 budgeted < 40ms for critical flows
Cost sensitivity: high for reranking & embeddings; target ARR economics to hit ~75k-300k ARR with usage-based pricing
Model preferences: preference for smaller distilled models for pricing decisions; also want ability to route to higher-quality fp16 model for edge-case scoring
Routing/fallback: automatic fallback to cheaper quantized variant under load; regional failover to dedicated pool; per-route SLO policies
Security/compliance: VPC + customer KMS, SSO/SAML, detailed audit logs, 12-mo retention, SOC2 compliance required
poc_plan: Phase 1 (week 1): baseline profiling on current infra (internal) — collect token counts, seq length dist
Phase 2 (week 2): Redwood hosted POC — run 1:1 model p50/p95 baseline (no quant)
Phase 3 (week 3): quantized variants and continuous-batching experiments; measure accuracy delta + latency/cost trade-offs
Phase 4 (week 4): VPC + KMS security review + canary routing test between dedicated and hosted
Deliverable: perf report with recommended batch size, cache TTLs, quantization profile + cost/latency table
perf_benchmark_requests: Request A: p95 latency bench for pricing model at 500 rps, concurrency 64, measured with and without prefix/KV cache
Request B: throughput sweep for quantized 8-bit vs fp16: tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99, and per-token cost estimate
Request C: batching sensitivity matrix — batch sizes 1, 4, 8, 16 for 128/512 seq lengths; measure latency tail and cost
Request D: canary routing test — induce 30% traffic spike, confirm fallback to dedicated pool within 15s, no error increase >0.1%
Request E: end-to-end checkout simulation (chat + rerank + embed) to measure cumulative latency budget and hotspot attribution
